about: A fictional inbox for a Claude Code workshop. Harbor & Pine Supply Co., Ridgeline Capital, Brightline Freight, Coastal Foods and every person here are made up.

owner.name: Jordan Avery
owner.title: Chief of Staff, Harbor & Pine Supply Co.

messages.subject: Revised rate card for 2027
messages.body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for the call yesterday. Can you confirm the revised 2027 rate card, including the fuel surcharge cap we discussed, in writing? Our ops team needs it before they lock the Q1 freight budget.

Best,
Jordan

messages.subject: RE: Revised rate card for 2027
messages.body:
Hi Jordan,

Got it. I'm waiting on sign-off from our pricing team and will confirm next week.

Dana

messages.subject: Lender call this morning
messages.body:
Priya,

I'll send you my notes from the lender call this afternoon so you have them before your covenant review.

Jordan

messages.subject: RE: Lender call this morning
messages.body:
Priya,

Notes from the lender call are below.

- They're comfortable with the Q4 leverage trajectory.
- They want the 13-week cash forecast monthly through Q1.
- Next check-in is mid-January.

Jordan

messages.subject: RE: Lender call this morning
messages.body:
Perfect, thank you.

Priya

messages.subject: Claude Code for the finance team
messages.body:
Hi Sam,

Can we get Claude Code approved for the finance team before the January close? Priya's team wants to try it on the month-end reconciliations. Happy to fill in whatever security review form you need.

Thanks,
Jordan

messages.subject: November cash forecast
messages.body:
Priya,

Could you send me the November cash forecast before board prep on December 10? I want to pull the headline numbers into the pre-read.

Thanks,
Jordan

messages.subject: Org chart for the board
messages.body:
Jordan,

The board will want to see the new operations leadership structure. Can you send me an updated org chart?

Elena
Operating Partner, Ridgeline Capital

messages.subject: RE: Org chart for the board
messages.body:
Elena,

Of course. I'll send you the revised org chart by Friday, December 4, once Kim confirms the two open roles.

Jordan

messages.subject: Coastal Foods renewal
messages.body:
Marcus,

What's the status of the Coastal Foods renewal? Are we still at risk of losing them after the October delivery issues?

Also, I'll set up a pricing review with you and Priya when I'm back from leave, so we have a view before the renewal call.

Jordan

messages.subject: October delivery credits
messages.body:
Jordan,

We had eleven late deliveries in October and two spoiled loads. Before we talk about renewing, we need to understand what Harbor & Pine is prepared to offer.

Angela Brooks
COO, Coastal Foods

messages.subject: RE: October delivery credits
messages.body:
Angela,

That's a fair ask, and I'm sorry for the disruption. I'll get back to you with a credit proposal next week.

Jordan

messages.subject: 100-day plan update
messages.body:
Elena,

Do you want the 100-day plan update inside the board deck, or as a separate memo?

Jordan

messages.subject: RE: 100-day plan update
messages.body:
Separate memo, please. Two pages max.

Elena

messages.subject: Warehouse manager coverage
messages.body:
Hi Kim,

Who's covering the Savannah warehouse manager role while Luis is on leave? Ops asked me and I didn't have an answer.

Thanks,
Jordan

messages.subject: December board meeting logistics
messages.body:
Hi Jordan,

The December board meeting is confirmed for December 15. When can we expect the pre-read?

Rachel Gomez
Board Coordinator, Ridgeline Capital

messages.subject: RE: December board meeting logistics
messages.body:
Hi Rachel,

I'll circulate the board pre-read by Wednesday, December 9.

Jordan

messages.subject: Shared drive access
messages.body:
Hi Jordan,

I don't have access to the strategy shared drive yet. Could you add me?

Tom

messages.subject: RE: Shared drive access
messages.body:
Tom, sorry about that. I'll get you access before I leave today.

Jordan

messages.subject: Out next week
messages.body:
Hi all,

I'm out from November 30 to December 4 and back on Monday, December 7. Priya is the point person for anything urgent.

Jordan

messages.subject: Weekly operations snapshot: week of Nov 23
messages.body:
This is an automated report.

On-time delivery: 93.8% (target 96%)
Order fill rate: 97.1%
Open customer escalations: 4

Full dashboard: internal link

messages.body:
This month: year-end planning checklist, a recap of the CFO roundtable, and new AI tools across the portfolio.

You're receiving this because you work at a Ridgeline portfolio company. Unsubscribe anytime.

messages.subject: RE: Shared drive access
messages.body:
Hi Jordan, just following up. I still can't open the strategy drive. No rush while you're out.

Tom

messages.subject: Q1 territory plan draft
messages.body:
Team,

The draft Q1 territory plan is in the sales folder. Comments by December 11, please.

Marcus

messages.subject: Reminder: December all-hands on the 17th
messages.body: Our December all-hands is on Thursday, December 17 at 10am in the Savannah warehouse break room and online. Submit questions for the leadership Q&A using the form on the intranet.

messages.subject: FYI: audit timeline
messages.body:
FYI, the auditors will start fieldwork on January 18. I'll share the request list once it's final.

Priya

messages.subject: Invitation: Board prep @ Thu Dec 10, 2pm
messages.body: Priya Nair has invited you to Board prep on Thursday, December 10 at 2:00pm.

messages.subject: Forklift recertification budget
messages.body:
Hi Jordan,

Before I go on leave: can you confirm whether the forklift recertification training is in the 2027 budget? The vendor needs an answer by December 18.

Luis
